crossRefs.note: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer…
This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill…
We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the…
Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…
Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to…
for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according…
The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword…
Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
His brothers, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom king David made…
Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out…
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart…
Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to…
He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
and killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:

translations.web: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
translations.bsb: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
translations.asv: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to the cities thereof with their borders, even the cities of the land round about.
